_meta.purpose: DRC-repair rule library for ASAP7 block layouts. Each entry maps a DRC rule CLASS to a coordinated repair transform, with the coupling hazards that make single-layer fixes fail. Used two ways: (1) parameterizes deterministic fixers, (2) injected (structure-matched) into the model prompt. Provenance: rule semantics (the DRC description states the constraint), EDA legalization literature (MDPI Electronics 2025 simulated-annealing standard-cell DRC repair; EDN automated DRC correction = cut-slide/merge/drop without creating new errors; USPTO 7,380,227 asymmetric-enclosure directional extension), and our own measured Block1 experiments (grow-via 315->387, shrink-metal 315->339: both fix the target rule but push the violation to an adjacent stack layer).

rules.semantics: The via (V) width perpendicular to the connected metal (M) length must EXACTLY equal that metal's width.
rules.transform: coordinated-stack-width: pick a consistent width W for the via-stack (via + metal-above + metal-below) at each flagged site; set via perpendicular dim = W, extend BOTH the upper and lower metal to enclose the via by their required margin, then snap the via edges to the via grid.
rules.coupling: Changing ONLY the via width breaks lower-metal enclosure (V.M(lower).EN) and via grid (V.AUX.1). Changing ONLY the metal width breaks the OTHER via's enclosure (upper V.M.EN) and its grid. Must edit via + both metals + grid together.
rules.provenance: semantics + measured (Block1 grow-via -> V2.M2.EN.1+72/V2.AUX.1+72; shrink-M3 -> V3.M3.EN.1+48/V3.AUX.1+48)

rules.semantics: Metal edges (horizontal for M4/M6, vertical for M5) must lie on an N-nm grid (M4=24, M5=24, M6=32).
rules.transform: snap each FLAGGED edge to the nearest grid line in the direction that PRESERVES via enclosure (never move an edge inward past a via it encloses); only touch edges DRC actually flagged, not the whole layer.
rules.coupling: Whole-layer snapping moves via-enclosing edges -> V.M.EN + V.AUX explosions (measured: M4/M5/M6 snap 315->510). Restrict to flagged, via-free edges.

rules.semantics: Metal must enclose the via by a minimum margin on the specified sides (often asymmetric, e.g. 5 & 2 nm).
rules.transform: extend the metal edge outward over the via by the required margin (directional, per USPTO 7,380,227). Grow only the metal, never move the via.
rules.coupling: Growing metal can create spacing violations with adjacent metal on the same layer; check the neighbour gap before extending.

rules.semantics: Minimum edge-to-edge spacing between two same-layer metal polygons (tip-to-tip / tip-to-side), conditional on edge lengths.
rules.transform: trim or shift the offending edge by the spacing deficit, moving the SHORTER/least-connected of the two shapes; prefer trimming a jog over moving a routed wire.
rules.coupling: Trimming can violate min-width or break via enclosure on the trimmed shape; shifting can create a new spacing violation with the next neighbour.
rules.provenance: semantics + EDN (cut-slide/merge without creating new errors)

rules.semantics: Minimum parallel run length of two adjacent-track metal polygons.
rules.transform: shorten the overlap (trim one end) or nudge one wire to a non-adjacent track.
rules.coupling: Trimming a routed wire can break its via landing; nudging can violate spacing on the new track.

rules.semantics: Polygon area must be >= a minimum.
rules.transform: grow the polygon (prefer along its routing direction) until min area is met; this rule is usually INDEPENDENT of the via stack -> safe deterministic win when no via is nearby.
rules.coupling: Growth can cause spacing; check neighbour gap.
